metric_definitions.Centroid_Distance: Euclidean distance between strategy centroid and real data centroid (lower is better)
metric_definitions.Mean_Cosine_Similarity: Average maximum cosine similarity to real samples (higher is better)
metric_definitions.Co_Clustering_Rate: Rate of co-occurrence in same clusters as real data (higher is better)
metric_definitions.Semantic_Drift_Score: Normalized deviation from real distribution (lower is better)
metric_definitions.Intra_Strategy_Diversity: Average pairwise distance within strategy (higher indicates more diversity)
metric_definitions.Distribution_Coverage: How well synthetic data covers real data distribution (higher is better)
